name: contact-detail
title: Contact Detail
description: Details of a method by which an entity such as a Person or OrganisationalUnit may be contacted.
notes: The Address class should be used to store physical or postal addresses. For all other types of contact details, this class should be used.
rdfs:comment: Details of a method by which an entity such as a Person or OrganisationalUnit may be contacted.

fields.name: contactDetail_pk
fields.title: Contact Detail (Primary Key)
fields.description: A unique identifier for an ltc:ContactDetail.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to guarantee uniqueness.
fields.rdfs:comment: A unique identifier for an ltc:ContactDetail.

fields.name: contactDetailCategory
fields.title: Contact Detail Category
fields.description: The method of contact to which the contact detail applies.
fields.notes: Recommended practice is to use a controlled vocabulary.
fields.rdfs:comment: The method of contact to which the contact detail applies.

fields.name: contactDetailFunction
fields.title: Contact Detail Function
fields.description: A brief label describing the nature of the enquiry or enquiries that are appropriate to direct to the contact detail.
fields.rdfs:comment: A brief label describing the nature of the enquiry or enquiries that are appropriate to direct to the contact detail.

fields.name: contactDetailValue
fields.title: Contact Detail Value
fields.description: The value of the contact detail, such as the phone number or email address.
fields.rdfs:comment: The value of the contact detail, such as the phone number or email address.
